LibraryCatalog.title: Book Catalog
LibraryCatalog.description: Every title the library holds, and the physical copies behind it.
LibraryCatalog.author: Author
LibraryCatalog.isbnHelper: Optional. Bangla reprints often share an ISBN or carry none.
LibraryCatalog.ddcHelper: Dewey Decimal class, if the section is shelved by it.
LibraryCatalog.subject: Subject
LibraryCatalog.isReferenceHelper: Off: this title can be borrowed.
LibraryCatalog.isReferenceOnHelper: On: consulted in the library, never issued.
LibraryCatalog.accessionDescription: Record the physical volumes now. A title with no copies is a name, not a book on a shelf.
LibraryCatalog.addCopiesDescription: New volumes of "{title}" for the accession register.
LibraryCatalog.printLabelsDescription: Spine labels with a scannable accession barcode, on A4.
LibraryCatalog.labelsSelectHint: {count} label(s) will print. Tick copies to print only some.
LibraryCatalog.importDescription: Bring an existing register in. Your own accession numbers are kept, never renumbered.
LibraryCatalog.importColumnsHelper: Only title and author are required. Rows with an accession number already on file are skipped, so re-running is safe.
LibraryCatalog.importSkipped: {count} row(s) skipped — already in the register
LibraryCatalog.createDescription: Catalogue a new title and accession its first copies.
LibraryCatalog.editDescription: Update the bibliographic record. Copies are managed from the book's own page.
LibraryCatalog.deleteDescription: "{title}" will be removed from the catalog. This is only possible while it has no copies in the register.
LibraryCatalog.withdrawDescription: Accession {accessionNo} will be marked withdrawn. Its line stays in the register — accession numbers are never reused.
LibraryCatalog.noHistory: This title has not been issued yet.
LibraryCatalog.acceptedFormats: Accepts .csv and .xlsx. Excel 97-2003 (.xls) must be saved as .xlsx or .csv first.
LibraryCatalog.importLegacyXls: Excel 97-2003 (.xls) is a different, older format. In Excel choose File > Save As and pick .xlsx or .csv, then try again.
LibraryCatalog.importUnsupportedFile: Only .csv and .xlsx files can be imported.
LibraryCatalog.importParseFailed: That file could not be read. Check it opens in Excel, and that the first row is the column headings.
LibraryCatalog.totalPriceHelper: What the whole delivery cost. It is split across the copies, and recorded as an expense when the source is Purchased.
LibraryCatalog.totalPricePerCopy: Tk {amount} per copy. Recorded as an expense when the source is Purchased.
LibraryCatalog.editCopyDescription: Accession {accessionNo}. Shelf position and value are per copy.
LibraryCatalog.copyPriceHelper: This copy's share of the delivery. Changing it does not alter the expense already recorded.

LibraryCirculation.title: Issue & Return
LibraryCirculation.description: The circulation desk: scan a card, scan a book, press Enter.
LibraryCirculation.borrowerPanelHelper: Scan the library card, or type a name or ID.
LibraryCirculation.bookPanelHelper: Scan each book. They are issued together on one due date.
LibraryCirculation.scanCardPlaceholder: Scan card, or type ID / name
LibraryCirculation.scanCardEmpty: Scan a library card to begin.
LibraryCirculation.scanBookEmpty: Scan a book to add it.
LibraryCirculation.scanWithCameraHelper: Point the camera at the barcode. Needs a secure (HTTPS) connection.
LibraryCirculation.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
LibraryCirculation.cameraBlocked: The camera could not be opened. Camera scanning needs HTTPS or localhost — the handheld scanner works either way.
LibraryCirculation.ambiguousCode: More than one person uses this code
LibraryCirculation.ambiguousHelper: Employee codes are not unique across teachers and staff. Pick the right person.
LibraryCirculation.alreadyInBasket: Accession {accessionNo} is already on the list.
LibraryCirculation.overFineThreshold: Outstanding fines are above the school's limit.
LibraryCirculation.dueDateHelper: Defaults to {days} days from today, skipping days the library is closed.
LibraryCirculation.overrideLimit: This would take them past their limit of {limit}.
LibraryCirculation.overrideFines: They owe more than the school allows.
LibraryCirculation.damagedOnReturnHelper: The copy goes back on the shelf flagged, so it can be repaired or withdrawn later.
LibraryCirculation.fineWillBeAssessed: A fine is calculated on return. Days the library was closed are not charged.
LibraryCirculation.waiveThisFineHelper: Recorded as waived with a reason, not silently skipped.
LibraryCirculation.renewDaysPlaceholder: Leave blank for the school default
LibraryCirculation.renewFromTodayHelper: The new due date runs from today, not from the old one.
LibraryCirculation.markLostHelper: The copy stays in the register as lost — its accession number is never reused.
LibraryCirculation.replacementCostPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the book's price
LibraryCirculation.replacementCostHelper: Defaults to the copy's price times the school's replacement multiplier.

LibraryFines.title: Fine Management
LibraryFines.description: Overdue, damage and replacement charges — assessed here, banked in Fee Collection.
LibraryFines.waiveReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Book was returned during the flood closure
LibraryFines.waiveHelper: Required — a waiver without a recorded reason cannot be audited.
LibraryFines.willPostToFeeCollection: This will be recorded in Fee Collection as a library fee, and will appear in the school's income statement.
LibraryFines.libraryLedgerOnly: Fee Collection holds student payments only, so this staff fine is recorded in the library ledger. It will show separately in the fine report.
LibraryFines.createDescription: For charges with no loan behind them — a damaged reference book, a lost card.
LibraryFines.editDescription: Only a pending fine can be edited; once collected the amount is history.
LibraryFines.deleteDescription: Fine {fineNo} will be removed. A collected fine cannot be deleted — waive it instead.
LibraryFines.pickBorrowerFirst: Choose who the fine is for.

LibraryReports.title: Library Reports
LibraryReports.description: Is the collection used, what is on the shelves, and where did the fine money go.
LibraryReports.financeGap: Tk {amount} of collected fines ({count}) is not in Fee Collection
LibraryReports.financeGapHelper: Fee Collection holds student payments only, so teacher and staff fines stay in the library ledger. They are listed here so the figure is visible rather than missing.
LibraryReports.stockHelper: Copies not physically sighted since {since}. Books out on loan are with a borrower, not missing.

LibrarySettings.title: Library Settings
LibrarySettings.description: Loan limits, fine rates and the accession counter.
LibrarySettings.accessionDescription: How each physical copy is numbered in the register. A number is permanent and never reused.
LibrarySettings.nextAccessionNoHelper: Moving from a paper register? Continue from your last used number.
LibrarySettings.loanRulesDescription: How many books each kind of borrower may take, and for how long.
LibrarySettings.renewalDaysHelper: Blank uses the borrower's normal loan length.
LibrarySettings.fineRulesDescription: What a late return costs, and what happens when a book does not come back.
LibrarySettings.fineGraceDaysHelper: Days after the due date before a fine starts.
LibrarySettings.fineBlockThresholdHelper: 0 warns the desk but still allows the issue.
LibrarySettings.countClosedDaysHelper: Off: vacations and government holidays are not charged, because the library was shut. The dates come from the Academic Calendar.
LibrarySettings.notificationsDescription: Email sent from the library. Overdue notices are sent from a button on the overdue list, not automatically.
LibrarySettings.notifyOnIssueHelper: A receipt with the due date.
LibrarySettings.dueReminderEnabledHelper: Scheduled when the book is issued, cancelled when it comes back.
LibrarySettings.notifyGuardiansHelper: Include a student's guardian on library email.
LibrarySettings.editDescription: Changing these changes how every other library screen behaves.
LibrarySettings.issueMailOn: A receipt is emailed on issue
LibrarySettings.categoriesDescription: The sections the collection is arranged into. Standard Bangladeshi school sections are created for you; rename, add or retire them here.
LibrarySettings.deleteCategoryDescription: "{name}" will be removed. This is only possible while no title is filed under it.
